title: Opening hours
readOnly: Only admins and owners can change opening hours.
intro: Guests can join only while you are open. Times are in your location's time zone, {{tz}}.
noHours: No hours are set, so the queue is open whenever it is not paused or closed.
clearDescription: With no hours set, the queue is open whenever it is not paused or closed.

errors.hours_overlap: {{day}} overlaps another interval. Change the times so they do not overlap.
errors.hours_invalid: {{day}} opens and closes at the same time.
errors.hours_too_many: {{day}} has too many intervals. Three is the most.
errors.permission_denied: You do not have permission to change opening hours.
errors.unknown: Opening hours could not be saved. Try again.

exceptions.title: Holidays and special hours
exceptions.intro: Closed days and one-off hours replace the weekly hours on that date.
exceptions.none: No holidays or special hours in the next 12 months.
exceptions.addDescription: Pick one date or a range. Each date gets the same hours.
exceptions.toHint: Leave empty for a single date.
exceptions.rangeInvalid: Pick a last date on or after the first, within a year.

errors.hours_overlap: One of those dates already has an exception. Remove it first.
errors.hours_invalid: Opening and closing time are the same.
errors.permission_denied: You do not have permission to change opening hours.
errors.unknown: The dates could not be saved. Try again.
